changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/3886/diffs?diff_id=230696587&start_sha=592e9d4b33baba61c11ea66ac92eac99e934d15d#00528c19b4917a1a44d673ac54d019e190f9558b_2095_2095)
Could you please assign to (extlen*4) - 4    to make it clearer (at least to me) ?

Section Extension Type 12 is referred in ORAN CUS specification(O-RAN.WG4.CUS.0-v05.00), chapter 5.4.7.12.
![table](/uploads/935c11f999a51f3f4bbb67ce44ab8357/table.png)
“extLen” field detailing how many 4-byte words are contained in the extension.
"-4" means that the "ef + extType + extLen + priority + symbolMask" occupies 4 bytes.

I understand how the extLen field works - I just wanted to make the precedence clearer.  In fact, I'd rather not subtract 4, but instead an expression involving offset (in case the fields before the pairs ever change).

Is 'R' (Resource Block Groups) effectively as many pairs as will fit into the extension? Or should it be taken from a field earlier in the section itself, or should it be added as a preference? Doesn't this mean that you will always fill an even number of pairs - could it ever be odd?

There is no field indicating how many pairs(offStartPrb and numPrb).
From the Table 5-36, we can calculate it. A pair(offStartPrb and numPrb) occupies 2 bytes.
As (extLen*4 - 4) is a multiple of 4, the number of pairs should be odd.

I think you mean the number of pairs will always be even?  I don't work with this protocol myself, but have added features on behalf of colleagues.  Sometimes params that are not in the protocol will be signalled by M-Plane, and we have added those values as preferences.  I am happy to assume R always fills up an even number of entries.
A better long text, from 5.4.7.12.4, could be "Number of PRBs in PRB range"
Thanks, i have modified it
